snippet.title: Netflix Minigolf | Official Game Trailer | Netflix
snippet.description:
Putt, prank, and compete your way through Stranger Things, Squid Game, and Bridgerton in Netflix’s new couch co-op party game. Up to 4 players, phones as controllers, chaos guaranteed. Go on. Putt Around and Find Out.

Play Netflix Minigolf, only on Netflix: https://www.netflix.com/minigolf

Subscribe: https://bit.ly/3Rw25E1

About Netflix:
Netflix is one of the world’s leading entertainment services offering TV series, films, games and live programming across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.

Netflix Minigolf | Official Game Trailer | Netflix
